source: Brothers and sisters, have youseen this? The reason that God renews our heart and gives us a new heart at the time of our regeneration is that He wants us to incline toward Him, adore Him,desire Him,and love Him.Before,we did not love Him and we could not love Him, because our heart was old and hard. Now He has renewed, softened, and turned our heart; thus, we are both able and willing to love Him. Since our heart by being renewed has become a new heart, it now has a new function. This new function is that it can incline toward God and love God and the things of God.

source: Internal Debts: A sum of ₹ 2,429.00 crore is estimated to be received from Internal Debts of the State.Internal Debts include various loans such as Market Loans which is projected at ₹ 900.00 crore, NABARD Loan is kept at ₹ 170.00 crore, National Co-operative Development Corporation Loan capped at ₹ 5.00 crore, Rural Electricity Corporation at ₹ 2.00 crore, Power Financing Corporation loan estimated at ₹ 2.00 crore and SIDBI loan of ₹ 350.00 crore.The Government vows to continue rural infrastructure development works through NABARD loans.Some of the major projects approved for funding under NABARD RIDF XXVII are Construction of CHCs, PHCs etc. & for Infrastructure and Logistic Supplies for Fighting the Ongoing Covid Pandemic with a total project outlay of ₹ 27.25 crore, Upgradation of Existing 17.9 km Road to Cement Concrete Pavement from Meidum - Hortoki (Phase-II) with a project amount of ₹ 133.66 crore, Construction of Separate 11kV Feeders for Power Supply to Agricultural Lands amounting to ₹ 12.25 crore, Soil Conservation Measures for Enhancement of Productivity in Mizoram with a total project cost of ₹ 10.00 crore and Six Irrigation Projects in Mizoram with a project amount of ₹ 10.47 crore. The State is also committed to take up more rural development projects in the coming Financial Year.

source: HON'BLE UNION MINISTER SHRI PARSHOTTAM RUPALA MEETS MAMIT DISTRICT OFFICIALS AND BENEFICIARIES. 83/2022-2023 Mamit 13th June, 2022: Shri PARSHOTTAM Rupala, Hon'ble Union Cabinet Minister, Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying today held a meeting with a District Officials and Beneficiaries of various centrally sponsor schemes at the conference hall of DC Mamit. The meeting was chaired by Pu Lalnunhlua DC Mamit. The Minister was appraised about the aspirational District programme undertakings and the present status in the delta ranking through power point presentation by Pu Lalsanglura, Nodal Officer of Aspirational District. Hon'ble Union Minister mentioned his purpose for his visited of the District and interaction with the Beneficiaries of various scheme. He assured full support for the proper implementation of the schemes so that the beneficiaries can enjoy the benefits as intended by the Government. In the meeting the Minister Interacted with the officials and beneficiaries of the following Central Scheme: AYUSHMAN BHARAT Health & Wellness, Ayushman Bharat Jan Arogya Yojana, e- Transaction, Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY), PM Street Vendor's Atma Nirbhar nidhi ( PM-Svanidhi), Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY), Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana ( Gramin/Urban), Jal Jeevan Mission ( Individual household connection & Schools), Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban/Gramin), PMMVY and PM-Kisan. Union minister is accompanied by the Director, Fisheries Department, Government of Mizoram and other Officials from Aizawl. Attachment Loading attachment...

Shri Parshottam Rupala, Union Minister chuan Mamit District a rawn tlawh chhan leh inkawmhona neih anih chhan sawiin Central Schemes hrang hrang District mipuite'n an hlawhtlinpui theih nan leh tha taka kalpui anih leh nih loh thlithlai a, harsatna awm angte hrechianga sutkianpui tura lokal anih thu a sawi a. District Concern Officers te pawhin Sorkar hmalakna Programme hrang hrang zirchiang a, beneficiaries te'n an hlawhtlinpui ngei theih nana tan la turin a fuih. PM-Kisan chu Aadhaar Card, ram leh Bank Account nei tan dil theih anih thu sawiin, a concern department te pawhin Mamit District chhunga kuthnathawktute'n he scheme atanga hlawkna mi tam thei ang berin an dawn theih nana tan la turin a chah bawk. Union Minister hian vawiin inkawmhona-a Sorkar Officials leh Beneficiaries te'n an harsatna leh mamawh an lo thlente chu a theih ang anga bawhzuisak a tum thu a sawi a ni. source: DEO LAWNGTLAI PUBLISHES DRAFT ELECTORAL ROLL 2020 District Election Officer (DEO), Lawngtlai Pi Shashanka Ala, IAS published a draft electoral roll 2020 of three assembly constituencies within Lawngtlai District tomorow at her office chamber and handed over the draft electoral rolls to representatives of the political parties. As per the draft electoral roll, there are 31372 voters (15852 males and 15520 females) in 36-Tuichawng (ST) A/C, 26926 voters (13524 males and 13402 females) in 37-Lawngtlai West (ST) A/C and 24000 voters (11626 males and 12374 females) in 38-Lawngtlai East (ST) A/C. In total, there are 82298 voters (41002 males and 41296 females) in Lawngtlai District. Claims and objections regarding the draft roll can be filed upto 15th January, 2020. The qualifying date for the roll is 1st January, 2020. Final electoral roll is scheduled to be published on 7th February, 2020. Meanwhile, 8 new polling stations in addition to the existing 62 stations in Tuichawng Constituency, 1 new polling station in addition to the existing 68 stations in Lawngtlai West Constituency and 7 new polling stations in addition to the existing 35 stations in Lawngtlai East Constituency are created resulting to the total number of 181 polling stations in Lawngtlai District. reference: LAWNGTLAIAH DRAFT ELECTORAL ROLL 2020 TLANGZARH A NI Kum 2020 atana Lawngtlai District-a Assembly bial pathuma draft electoral roll chu Nimin (16.12.2019) khan Lawngtlai District Election Officer, Lawngtlai Bawrhsap ni bawk Pi Shashanka Ala, IAS chuan a office chamber-ah a tlangzarh a. Draft roll hi political party ai awhte hnenah a hlan nghal. Draft electoral roll tlangzarh tak atanga a lan danin, 36-Tuichawng (ST) A/C bialah vote nei mipa 15852 leh hmeichhia 15520, an vaiin mi 31372 an awm a; 37-Lawngtlai West (ST) A/C bialah vote nei mipa 13524 leh hmeichhia 13402, an vaiin mi 26926 an awm a; 38-Lawngtlai East (ST) A/C bialah voter mipa 11626 leh hmeichhia 12374, an vaiin mi 24000 an awm a; assembly bial pathumah hian vote nei mipa 41002 leh hmeichhia 41296, an vaiin mi 82298 an awm a ni. Summary revision neih turah hian sawi duh neite tan kum thar January ni 15 thleng hun hawn a ni a. February ni 7, 2020-ah final electoral roll chu tar chhuah tura tih a ni. Hemi rual hian Tuichawng biala polling station 62 awm saah a thar 8 hawn belh niin, polling station 70 a awm tawh dawn a; Lawngtlai West-a polling station awm sa 68-ah a thar 1 hawn belh niin, polling station 69 a awm tawh ang a; Lawngtlai East-a polling station awm sa 35 baka a thar hawn belh 7 nen polling station 42 awm tawhin, Lawngtlai District chhunga bial pathumah hian a vaiin polling station 181 a awm tawh dawn a ni. raw_text:
DEO LAWNGTLAI-IN DRAFT ELECTORAL ROLL 2020 A PUANG

District Election Officer (DEO), Lawngtlai Pi Shashanka Ala, IAS chuan Lawngtlai District chhunga assembly constituency pathum te draft electoral roll 2020 chu niminah a office chamber-ah a puang a, political party te thawhpuite hnenah draft electoral roll-te pawh a hlan bawk.

Draft electoral roll angin, 36-Tuichawng (ST) A/C-ah voter 31372 an awm a, mi pasal 15852 leh hmeichhia 15520 an ni. 37-Lawngtlai West (ST) A/C-ah voter 26926 an awm a, mi pasal 13524 leh hmeichhia 13402 an ni. 38-Lawngtlai East (ST) A/C-ah voter 24000 an awm a, mi pasal 11626 leh hmeichhia 12374 an ni. A pumpuiin, Lawngtlai District-ah voter 82298 an awm a, mi pasal 41002 leh hmeichhia 41296 an ni.

Draft roll chungchanga claims leh objections te chu 15th January, 2020 thleng thehluh theih a ni. Roll atan qualifying date chu 1st January, 2020 a ni. Final electoral roll chu 7th February, 2020-ah puan chhuah tum a ni.

Tin, Tuichawng Constituency-a polling station awm sa 62 bakah polling station thar 8 dah belh a ni a, Lawngtlai West Constituency-a polling station awm sa 68 bakah polling station thar 1 dah belh a ni bawk a, Lawngtlai East Constituency-a polling station awm sa 35 bakah polling station thar 7 dah belh a ni a, hei hian Lawngtlai District-a polling station zawng zawng 181 a awm theihna a siam a ni.

source:
Not long after I was released from prison, I became
seriously ill with tuberculosis. I was confined to bed for six
months of absolute rest, followed by two and a half years
of greatly restricted activity for recovery. Outwardly speak-
ing, those days were really dark. But, I tell you, whenever
I prayed I felt that I was not in bed. but in the heavens.
Though I was gravely ill, yet when I prayed I had the sense
that I was not in illness, but far above it all in the heavens.
You do not know what kind of pleasure I had in the Lord
in those days. Imprisonment and persecution, then poverty
and illness. But, praise the Lord, the ascended Christ was
my way! The transcendent Christ was my way to the
heavens.

Second Corinthians 3:16 says, “Whenever their heart turns

our heart was turned away from the Lord. But when we re-
pented, our heart was turned to the Lord. This matter of turn-
ing the heart to the Lord is not done once for all. The heart 
must be turned to the Lord all the time, day by day. Every morn-
ing we must turn our heart again toward the Lord. After rising, 
we should go to the Lord and tell Him, “Lord, here I am. By 
Your mercy and grace I wish to turn my heart anew to You for 
this day.”

source: AGRI-MARKETING & TRAINING INFRASTRUCTURE BUILDING INAUGURATED AT LUNGLEI No.523/2021-2022 Aizawl, the 28th February 2022 : Commerce & Industries (C&I) Minister Dr R Lalthangliana on Saturday (26th February, 2022) inaugurated Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building at Electric Veng, Lunglei. The Rs. 1082.93 lakhs project is implemented under the NABARD, RIDF XXIII. Lunglei HPC Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng was the guest of honour at the inauguration. At the inaugural function chaired by Commerce & Industries Department Commissioner & Secretary, Pi Esther Lal Ruatkimi, Commerce & Industries (C&I) Minister Dr R Lalthangliana commended C&I Department staff, Electric veng YMA, VCs for their contribution towards successful completion of the project. As per Technical Report presented by AIE Constructions, Tuikhuahtlang, Aizawl, the 5 floors Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building has a plinth area of 574.875 Square metres. The first floor is intended to be used as a training and awareness centre for agriculture marketing with an estimated capacity of 300 people, with guest rooms, conference/meeting rooms at the Ground floor. Basement I and Basement II contain the market areas and market offices, with a parking area at the basement.
reference: COMMERCE & INDUSTRIES MINISTER-IN LUNGLEIAH AGRI-MARKETING & TRAINING INFRASTRUCTURE BUILDING HAWNG No.4122/2021-2022 Aizawl, the 26 th February 2022 : Commerce & Industries (C&I) Minister Dr R Lalthangliana chuan vawiin khan Electric Veng, Lungleiah NABARD sum cheng nuai 1082.93 senga ruahman Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building a hawng. Hawnna inkhawm Commerce & Industries Department Commissioner & Secretary, Pi Esther Lal Ruatkimi kaihhruaiah Dr R Lalthangliana chuan Lunglei khawpui chhunga hmasawnna ruhrel liantham, khawtlang tana chhenfakawm tak leh eizawnna kawnga tangkai taka hman theih tur Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building zawhfel a ni chu lawmawm tiin a buaipuitu Commerce & Industries thawktute, building sa tu te leh Electric Veng Lunglei khawtlang te chungah lawmthu a sawi a. C&I Department hnuaiah hmalakna hrang hrang kalpui mek zel anih thu sawiin Lunglei Supermarket sakna tur cheng nuai 1400 NEC atanga sanction hmuh anih thu sawiin Bangladesh ram nena kan insumdawn tawnna atana ruahman Integrated Check Post (ICP), Kawrpuichhuah, Tlabung ti hlawhtling turin Department chuan theihtawp a chhuah mek zel thu a sawi a ni. A Department chan dangte hnuaia hmalaknte pawh sawilangin Minister chuan MZU Southern Campus atan DPR cheng vaibelchhe 400 sawrkar laipuiah thehluh tawh niin chak taka bawhzui mek a ni a, MZU Southern Campus tana hman lailawk tur Engineering College building chei that hna pawh thawh mek a ni, a ti a. Civil Hospital Lungleia Trauma Centre sak pawh zawh fel thuai beisei anih thu sawiin Multipurpose Laboratory Building, NEC sum cheng nuai 300 a ruahman mek pawh nakum kum tir lama zawhfel beisei anih thu a sawi. Lunglei Municipal Council (LMC) chungchang pawh sawiin Minister chuan Municipal body chak tak enkawlna hnuaiah Lunglei khawpui chuan kawng hrang hrangin hmasawnna a nei dawn a ni, a ti. He huna khualzahawm Lunglei HPC Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng chuan Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building hawn theiha peih fel a ni ta chu Pathian malsawmna ropui tak a ni tiin he hmasawnna ruhrel neih theihna tura sulsutute thawhrimna leh thahnemngaihna rah a ni, a ti a. He building ti hlawhtling tura bultan tu Pu Joseph Lalhimpuia chungah leh a hmun phal taka petu Electric Veng YMA te chungah lawmthu a sawi a ni. He building sak enkawltu AIE Constructions, Tuikhuahtlang, Aizawl atangin Technical Report ngaihtlak a ni a. Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure hi NABARD, RIDF XXIII hnuaia project niin total project cost hi Rs. 1082.93 lakhs ani a. Hna hi 05/10/2018 ah thawh tan a ni. A building plinth area hi 574.875 Square metres niin building hi floor nga (5) a sak a ni a. First floor hi Agriculture leh marketing lama training leh awareness centre atan ruahman niin mihring 300 vel leng tura hisap a ni. Ground floor ah hian guest room, conference/meeting room te awmin Basement I ah hian mi 78 lenna market area bakah market office ruamhan niin Basement II ah mi 85 lenna market area niin Basement III hi motor 25 lenna parking area-a ruahman a ni. source: MIZORAM RAJYA SABHA M.P CALLS FOR CENTRAL GOVERNMENTâ€™S INTERVENTION FOR RESTORATION OF PEACE IN MYANMAR. No.612/2020-2021 Aizawl, 15th March,2021 : Mizoram Rajya Sabha M.P K.Vanlalvena called on Shri Venkaiah Naidu, Chairman, Rajya Sabha and Vice President of India today at his official residence and calls for the central governmentâ€™s intervention for restoration of peace in the trouble torn Myanmar, and to provide relief measures for Myanmar nationals who crossed international border to take shelter in Mizoram following gross atrocities committed against protesters who stand up for democracy, human rights and justice since the military junta took control of the Myanmar government. During his meeting with the Vice President, Vanlalvena was accompanied by MNF party Adviser Rosangzuala. Both raised their concern that situation in Myanmar could go from bad to worse. While many protesters have lost their lives and many more suffer injuries, a large number of protesters are arbitrarily arrested and detained. In view of the grim situation, Vanlalvena urged the central government to stand up for the people of Myanmar and review its foreign policy towards Myanmar and try to find solution for the restoration of peace and harmony in the country. While raising internatioanl issues, Vanlalvena also asked the Vice Prsident to take necessary measures for induction of a member from Mizo community in the Union Public Service Commission and to create a separate cadre for Mizoram in All India Civl Service saying, 35 years since statehood is a period long enough for Mizoram to share the AGMUT cadre. He also raised the need to open an examination centre in Aizawl for Staff Selection Commission. Attachment Loading attachment...

source: LUNGLEI DISTRICT - COVID-19 NO TOLERANCE FORTNIGHT No.318/2020-2021 â€˜COVID - 19 No Tolerance Fortnightâ€™ (26 th October to 9 th November 2020) - A Zero Tolerance Drive with an objective to break the chain of infection through strict observance of SOPS and Guidelines, commenced yesterday at Lunglei District along with the rest of the State. â€˜COVID - 19 No Tolerance Fortnightâ€™ Banners have been put up in prominent locations along the main spine of the District capital, Lunglei town. source: MIZORAM CHIEF SECRETARY LEADS GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES IN TAKING INTEGRITY PLEDGE 275/2023-2024 Vigilance Awareness Week, 2023 is to be observed in the whole of India from today, i.e. 30th October till 5th November, 2023. This year the theme is - 'Say no to corruption, commit to the Nation'. Starting off the Vigilance Week in Mizoram too, Chief Secretary Dr. Renu Sharma led the officials and staff of the Mizoram Secretariat, MINECO this morning in taking the 'Integrity Pledge' in the Secretariat Courtyard. Likewise, all Heads of Offices under the State Government also led the employees in their respective offices in taking the Integrity Pledge, in which each government servant avowed to follow probity and rule of law in all walks of life, to neither take nor offer bribe, to perform all tasks in an honest and transparent manner, to act in public interest, to lead by example exhibiting integrity in personal behavior and to report any incident of corruption to the appropriate agency. source: HEALTH MINISTER DR. R. LALTHANGLIANA FLAGGED OFF 11 MOBILE MEDICAL VAN IN MAMIT DISTRICT No.541/2020-2021 Dr. R. Lalthangliana Health Minister flagged off 11 Bolero Campers designed for Mobile medical van to be used in rural areas of Mamit Aspiration District. Health Minister specially thank REC Ltd for their selfless help through their CSR initiatives in fostering aspiring district like Mamit which would help them aspire i in various development fields. Bolero Camper (4WD BS6) 11 nos were bought for - Rs. 1,04,50,000/- under REC Ltd. CSR initiative as reported by Nodal Officer Beitlotha Nohro. Also Laptop & Speaker consisting of 52 nunbers worth Rs. 24,60,000/- was also handed over by the minister to CMO and DMS Mamit District hospital. Essential Drugs & Diagnostic kits 76 nos - worth Rs.15,60,000/- and Folic Acid, Oral rehydration salt, Ibuprofen, Ascorbic Acid (vitamin C), Albendazole, Paracetamol and other Diagnostic Kits of 50 nos and Sahli's Haemoglobinometer, Pregnancy Test Kit, Malaria Test Kit, Typhoid Test Kit, BP Instrument Mercurial, Adult Weighing Machine, Hepatitis B-Test Kit etc were given out in the same programme. Er. H. Lalzirliana, Mamit A/C MLA, Pu C. Lalrammawia, Chairman ZOHANCO, Health Department Officials and NGOs and Village Council leaders were present at the programme. The Flagged off programme was chaired by the DC Mamit himself Dr. Lalrozama IAS. Attachment Loading attachment...
reference: HEALTH MINISTER-IN MAMIT DISTRICT CHHUNGA HMAN TUR MOBILE MEDICAL VAN LEH HMANRAW DANGTE VAILIAM No.7589/2020-2021 Vawiin khan Dr. R. Lalthangliana, Minister, Health & Family Welfare Department, Higher & Technical Education, Commerce & Industries chuan Mobile Medical Van, Essential Drugs & Diagnostic Kits & Laptops and Speaker Mamit District Hospital, PHC/CHC leh Sub- Centre-a hman tur vailiam. Khuallian Dr. R Lalthangliana chuan Mamit District chhunga cheng te'n hriselna kawnga hma an sawn theihna tura hmanraw tangkai tak taka thuam an ni chu a lawmawm thusawiin District - 11 zinga Medical Doctor ngei District Bawrhsap, hriselna kawnga a ngaihna hria in nei chu in vannei takzet a. Aspirational District atangin Mizoram District 11- te zingah pakhatna ni thei tura tan la tura chahin in tum tlat chuan theihloh a awm lo a ni tiin kum zabi 21-a hmasawnna chu hmang tangkaiin dik taka kan hmachhawn chuan District hnufual ber thin kha a ropui ber kan ni thei a ni a ti. Dr. Thangtea chuan Pathian ringtu mizo nih hi a nuama, pi leh pute atanga lungrual tak leh inpumkhatna nena thawkho thin kan nihna chuan rah tha chhuah zelin, Covid - 19 avanga nunna chan kan nei erawh pawi hle rualin hri dona kawnga kan hmalakna-a hlawhtlinna kan hmuh mekte leh India hmarchhak State pariat (8) zingah Covid - 19 vanga thi tlemna ber State kan ni chu Pathian avang leh kan thawhhona avang a ni a ti. Minister chuan hmasawnna kan hmuh mekte chu chho zawnga thlira in delhbeh tir mai lovin hmasawnna tluantling nei turin kan tih ve theih tawk theuha tan la thar turin kalkhawmte a fuih a. Kawngpui tha nei turin hmalakna kalpui mek niin khawchhak lam atanga khawthlang lam hawiin kawngsial hna thawh tan mek a nih thu a sawi bawk. Er. H. Lalzirliana, Bialtu MLA pawhin Mamit District-in hriselna kawnga hma kan sawn theihna tur leh Aspirational District kan nihna atanga khaichhuah kan nihna tura CSR hnuai atanga hmanraw tangkai tak tak lei a ni chu lawmawm a tih thusawiin Kan District Bawrhsap-in hemi kawnga hma a lakna chu fakawm a tih thu a sawi a. Covid-19 hripuiin khawvel a tih buai mek karah Mizoram chu Sorkar hmalakna chak tak a vang te, Kohhran mite tawngtaina vang te leh khawtlang hruaitute hmalakna avangin India ram state zingah a titha ber pawl kan ni chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi bawk. Bialtu MLA chuan Mamit District-in kawngpui tha kan neih chu Mizoram Sawrkarin a ngaihpawimawh berte zing a mi a nih avangin chak taka hmalakna kalpui a ni a, hun reilote-ah kawngpui tha kan nei thuai a beisei thu a sawi. Mamit District-in hriselna lama hma kan sawna, nu naupai te'n enkawlna tha zawk an dawn a, damdawi an mamawh angte an hmuh theihna tur bakah damlote enkawlna tha zawk leh rang zawk pek an nih theihna tura District chhung PHC/CHC leh Health Sub- Centre-te tana hmanraw lei hi Mamit District Bawrhsap hmalakna-in REC LTD, CSR Health Project hnuai atanga lei a ni. Vawiin-a sem tak Bolero Camper(4WD BS6) 11 lei nan hian Rs. 1,04,50,000/- hman niin Motor-te hi Health Care delivery a bik takin vaccination drive, Health camp conduct leh awareness pekna tur bakah, kawng that lohna hmun, motor naran in a thlen theih lohna khuate awlsam taka thlen theihnan 4 wheeled drive lei a ni a. Rs. 15,60,000/- senga lei damdawi chi hrang hrang 76 - Folic Acid, Oral rehydration salt, Ibuprofen, Ascorbic Acid (vitamin C), Albendazole, Paracetamol leh Diagnostic Kits 50 - Sahli's Haemoglobinometer, Pregnancy Test Kit, Malaria Test Kit, Typhoid Test Kit, BP Instrument Mercurial, Adult Weighing Machine, Hepatitis B-Test Kit leh a dangte Sub Centre/Health & Wellness Centre- te hman tur khuallian hian a hlan bawk. He Project hian a tum ber chu Health & welness Centre hi mi tam zawkin health care services an dawn theihna tur leh a tlawhtute mamawh damdawi leh diagnostic kit te a thlawna pek chhuah a ni a, health and welness centre hi mi tam zawkin hmang tangkaia, an tlawh tam (footfall) nana kalpui a ni. Vawiin vek hian Rs. 24,60,000/- senga lei Laptop leh Speaker 52, Mamit District chhung khua tlawh pawh harsa leh health care facility nei thalo khuate tan awlsam zawka health care provider te an biak pawh zung zung theihna turin Telemedicine atan Health Department hnenah hlan a ni bawk. He hun hi Dr. Lalrozama, IAS, Deputy Commissioner chuan kaihruaiin, Pu Beitlotha Nohro, SDC pawhin report pe-in Health Project hnuaiah Aspirational District kan nih avanga hriselna lama hma kan sawn theihna tura thuam kan nih dante a tarlang a. Dr. Vanlalfela, Chief Medical Officer, Mamit-in lawmthu sawina a nei bawk. Minister hi Er. H. Lalzirliana, 3-Mamit Bialtu MLA, Pu C. Lalrammawia, Chairman, ZOHANCO, Health Department Officials, Mamit khawpui chhunga Head of Offices bakah khawtlang hruaitute'n leh thutharthehdarhtute'n an tawiawm a ni. God’s Word says, “And Hezekiah was glad for them and showed them his treasury, the silver and the gold, and the spices and the precious oil, and his whole armory and everything which was found among his treasures” (v. 2). He encouraged the medical community to revive their efforts and recommit themselves in serving the public. Established in 1976, the Mizoram State Branch of IMA currently has 750 members out of which 33 are newly inducted.
